text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that incident at summer 
training camp, Admire Vega had begun 
having nightmares almost every night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A recurring nightmare where her younger 
sister condemned her for forgetting her 
penance and enjoying the race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Never again will I run just for myself—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a sorrowful resolve in her heart, 
Admire Vega headed toward the stage of the 
Kikuka Sho.
